definitions: To be secluded or protected from the harsh realities of life.
To be out of touch with everyday concerns and practical matters.
examples: The professor seemed to live in an ivory tower, unaware of student struggles.
Politicians who live in an ivory tower often lose touch with their constituents.
It's easy to live in an ivory tower when you've never faced real hardship.
lemma: to live in an ivory tower
source: to live in an ivory tower
